items.html: And below, in the order of the clothing of the RDL"A, called Atik Yomin, within the Rosh of AA, it will be explained how this second head, called the air that sits upon this Mocha Stima'ah, which is the third head of AA, is drawn from the aspect of this RDL"A of Atik Yomin, which could not clothe in Arich Anpin, and showed its light in this head of Vav, called the air. And understand this. And see below what the matter of this air is.
